name: Paper
author: James Myers
description: Printing, finally. Paper finds the printers on your network over DNS-SD, asks each one directly over IPP what it is doing, and shows the CUPS queue in the bar. Print by dropping a file on it. It never asks for a root password, because it never needs one.

schema.label: Hide when nothing is printing
schema.description: Keep the bar clean. The widget reappears the moment a job is queued or a printer needs attention.

schema.label: Refresh every (seconds)
schema.description: How often to ask CUPS and the printers. Discovery runs on a much slower cycle of its own.

schema.label: Print to
schema.description: Which queue a dropped file goes to. Empty uses the CUPS default destination.

schema.label: Double-sided by default
schema.description: Send jobs two-sided when the printer supports it.
